source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    border = grid[0][0]
    left_w = 0
    while left_w < w and grid[0][left_w] == border:
        left_w += 1
    inner_w = left_w - 2
    bounds = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == border for c in range(left_w))]
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    right_start = left_w + 1
    panels = []
    for top, bottom in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
        rows = list(range(top + 1, bottom))
        template = [[grid[r][c] == border for c in range(1, left_w - 1)] for r in rows]
        panels.append((rows, template))
    masks = []
    for rows, _ in panels:
        cells = [[grid[r][right_start + c] for c in range(inner_w)] for r in rows]
        colors = {v for row in cells for v in row if v != 0}
        if len(colors) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"expected one object color per panel, got {colors}")
        color = next(iter(colors))
        holes = [[v == 0 for v in row] for row in cells]
        masks.append((color, holes))
    for rows, template in panels:
        matches = [color for color, holes in masks if holes == template]
        if not matches:
            raise ValueError("no object mask matches panel")
        color = matches[0]
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            for j in range(inner_w):
                out[r][j + 1] = border if template[i][j] else color
    return out
'''
pfile=programs/'task-a3b24e0b.py'; pfile.write_text(source)
print(pfile)
